tsla.commentary: 오늘 장(8월10일) 장중 +0.7%(331달러) 보합권. 반등 3일째. 200일선 대비 -19%, RSI 43. 이 분석의 매수 타이밍 원칙은 "사람들이 가장 두려워할 때"이고, RSI가 과매도에서 방향을 튼 구간이 그 자리 — 지금이 거기. 다만 200일선 아래(Gear 1)라 본대는 아직: 3-3-4의 1차 30%까지. 2차 30%는 200일선 회복 확인 후, 3차 40%는 추세 확정 후. 손절은 원칙대로 직전 저점 이탈 시 기계적으로 — 감정 배제. 반등 3일째라 이미 1차는 들어가 있어야 할 시점 — 비어 있다면 지금이라도.
tsla.commentaryEn: Today's session (Aug 10), intraday: +0.7% ($331), little changed. A 3-day rebound with RSI at 43,  -19% versus the 200-day line. The buy timing in this framework is "when people are most afraid," and a turn up out of oversold is exactly that spot. Still below the 200-day line, so this is the first 30% tranche only — the second 30% waits for a reclaim of the 200-day, the final 40% for trend confirmation. Cut mechanically on a break of the prior low.

NVDA splits at its trend line: a 69% win rate over 20 sessions above the 200-day (Gear 3) versus 56% below — trend maintenance is the core of the judgment. The price sits above its 200-day line, so holding is the side of the trade, and the overheating reading (sell pressure 37) has no predictive power here — not a reason on its own to trim.

AAPL.commentaryEn: Today's session (Aug 10), intraday: -2.0% ($307), in progress. AAPL is the least signal-sensitive of the nine — neither extreme buy scores nor overheating readings carried a statistical edge. Having little to decide is precisely this stock's character. On today's numbers: buy score 75, sell pressure 22, RSI 43, with the price sitting +9.9% versus its 200-day line. Distance to the next signal: 53 points to the overheating line (sell pressure 75). What would change this call is a single one: the price slipping below its 200-day line. Until then, simply holding has been the favorable side on this stock.

Distance to the next signal: 22 points to the deeply-oversold signal (RSI 30) · 58 points to the overheating line (sell pressure 75). What would change this call is only a deep sell-off (RSI below 30) — a wobbling trend has not been much to fear on this particular stock.
